faqs.resolution: Thank you for reaching out regarding your billing inquiry. You can view and download all your invoices securely from the 'Billing' section of your Worklabs Client Dashboard. If you need a specific receipt resent, please let us know.

It looks like you need help accessing your account. You can reset your password immediately using this link: https://worklabz.co.uk/reset-password. If you continue to experience issues, please reply to this email and our L2 support team will assist you.

Thank you for the fantastic suggestion! We are constantly evolving the Worklabs platform based on client feedback. I have forwarded your feature request directly to our Product Team for consideration in the next roadmap meeting.
